About Anthropic
Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
About the role
As a Strategic Deals Lead, you will help shape Anthropic's long-term approach to AI infrastructure, compute capacity, and strategic ecosystem partnerships, and you will originate, structure, negotiate, and close the deals that put that strategy into effect. Within Cloud Compute, you will build and manage Anthropic's relationships across the emerging compute ecosystem to identify and execute opportunities that expand access to the infrastructure required to train and serve frontier AI systems.
The compute market is fast-moving and structurally complex. Providers vary widely in scale, financial structure, and commercial model, and increasingly involve a variety of strategic partners. In this role, you will build and develop expertise across the relevant ecosystem players, commercial constructs and market standards, and the interplay between infrastructure and financing for scaling compute.
You will work closely with Anthropic's technical infrastructure, finance, and legal teams to source and evaluate opportunities, develop deal economics, structure financing, and ensure transactions align with Anthropic's compute strategy. We are looking for someone with prior relevant transaction experience who is comfortable building and executing on a broad, active pipeline independently from day one.
Key responsibilities
Build and manage a pipeline of capacity across the integrated compute ecosystem
Maintain and own executive level relationships with commercial, finance, and legal counterparts at providers across all stages of maturity
Lead the full deal lifecycle for capacity agreements, from initial engagement and relationship development through negotiation, structure, and close of transactions
Bring capital markets and finance expertise to transactions, developing frameworks for evaluating deal economics, counterparty risk, and the financing components of compute infrastructure
Partner with infrastructure and technical teams to translate compute requirements into commercial terms and long-term supply strategies across the provider ecosystem
Develop and maintain deep market intelligence on the emerging cloud and integrated compute landscape, including provider positioning, pricing dynamics, commercial model evolution, and the competitive dynamics shaping capacity access
Represent Anthropic externally with corporate executives, investment banks, and infrastructure investors involved in transactions
Drive internal alignment on transaction terms, risk parameters, and strategic priorities for Anthropic's compute supply
Minimum qualifications
Background in investment banking, private equity, or infrastructure investing, with direct experience in data center, cloud, or technology sector transactions
Personal track record of originating, structuring, and closing cloud capacity, data center, or infrastructure transactions as the commercial, financing, or investing principal
Deep familiarity with the compute ecosystem, including fluency in how different types of providers price and contract, how capacity commitments are structured, and how the integrated compute market operates
Working understanding of the financing and infrastructure requirements of compute infrastructure projects
Preferred qualifications
8-10+ years of experience in investment banking, infrastructure investing, or principal finance roles with ownership of cloud, data center, or compute transactions
Experience managing multiple high-value transactions simultaneously at different stages of maturity and commercial development
Demonstrated ability to build and maintain senior-level relationships with counterparts at commercially sophisticated, capital-intensive organizations
Strong financial modeling skills, including the ability to build and pressure-test economics for large infrastructure projects
Comfort operating in fast-moving, ambiguous environments where market structures, provider economics, and deal norms are still evolving
A genuine interest in the trajectory of AI infrastructure and in Anthropic's mission of building safe, beneficial AI

Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit
anthropic.com/careers
directly for confirmed position openings.
How we're different
We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
Come work with us!
Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

jobs.description: Lead the engineering team building the large-scale attribution systems that help advertisers understand how their advertising investments drive meaningful customer and business outcomes — processing more than 50 billion events per day to produce the measurements consumed across all of Amazon Ads. Your team's work directly influences how advertisers understand the value of Amazon Ads, how campaigns and automated systems optimize investments, and ultimately how Amazon's advertising business grows. Attribution is at the heart of advertising measurement — connecting ad interactions with downstream outcomes such as purchases, subscriptions, and conversions. Building accurate attribution at Amazon scale is a uniquely challenging engineering and scientific problem: our systems must connect signals across complex customer journeys, advertising products, devices, and channels while navigating fragmented identity signals, evolving privacy requirements, changing measurement methodologies, and increasingly sophisticated advertiser needs. Small decisions in data processing or attribution methodology can affect measurement for millions of advertisers and influence how significant advertising investments are allocated. Our technology stack includes large-scale data processing using Apache Spark and Amazon EMR, data storage and processing with Apache Iceberg, DynamoDB, and S3, and distributed services built on AWS cloud-native infrastructure. jobs.description: About the Team OpenAI’s mission is to ensure that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. Our Communications team’s ethos is to support OpenAI’s mission and goals by clearly and authentically explaining our technology, values, and approach to safely building powerful AI. About the Role OpenAI is seeking an experienced communications professional to join our Platform & Research Communications team. This role will work closely with the Research Communications Lead and partner deeply with safety researchers, alignment researchers, and cross-functional teams to shape how OpenAI’s safety research is understood by researchers, journalists, policymakers, and the broader public. This position is responsible for developing and executing external communications strategies around OpenAI’s safety research—from alignment and evaluations to broader work that helps advance the safe development and deployment of increasingly capable AI systems. The ideal candidate brings strong science or technical fluency, excellent storytelling instincts, and experience helping researchers communicate complex work with clarity, accuracy, and nuance. You will partner closely with research leadership, individual researchers, policy, product, safety, legal, and cross-functional communications teams. This role requires both strategic judgment and hands-on execution in a fast-moving environment where research, public understanding, and high-stakes safety narratives intersect. This role is based in San Francisco, CA and follows a hybrid schedule (three days per week in office). Relocation assistance is available. In this role, you will: Shape Safety Research Narratives Develop clear, credible external narratives around OpenAI’s safety research, including alignment, evaluations, preparedness, interpretability, and other areas connected to the safe development of frontier AI. Translate complex technical work into accessible stories without oversimplifying, overstating impact, or creating unnecessary alarm. Help define and reinforce OpenAI’s POV on key safety research topics and how they connect to OpenAI’s broader research roadmap and mission. Partner Deeply with Researchers Work directly with safety and alignment researchers to understand their work, identify the most important ideas, and help position those ideas publicly. Serve as a communications thought partner to researchers—helping them anticipate questions, clarify implications, and communicate with precision. Build communications plans that help researchers share their work through the right channels, at the right level of depth, and with the right context. Lead Proactive Storytelling & Content Strategy Develop proactive storytelling opportunities across blogs, explainers, video, podcasts, events, and other channels beyond traditional media. Help identify creative ways to elevate safety research and make the work more legible to expert and non-expert audiences. Look across the safety research portfolio to identify broader themes, narrative opportunities, and moments where OpenAI can contribute meaningfully to public understanding. Support Research Launches & Publications Partner with research teams to plan communications for major papers, evaluations, model-related research, safety initiatives, and other technical publications. Collaborate with editorial, design, social, policy, and research teams on blogs, explainers, visuals, briefing materials, and supporting content. Ensure launches are grounded in evidence, appropriately scoped, and aligned with OpenAI’s safety, policy, and communications priorities. Lead Research-Focused Media Engagement. Build and maintain trusted relationships with science, technology, AI, and business journalists who cover frontier AI and safety research. Manage proactive and reactive media engagement related to safety research announcements, papers, collaborations, and emerging narratives. Prepare researchers and executives for interviews, briefings, events, and public appearances. Cross-Functional Partnership Work closely with Product, Policy, Safety, Legal, Marketing, and other Communications teams to align safety research communications with broader company goals. Partner with teams managing crisis and reactive safety communications to ensure clear coordination, while maintaining focus on proactive research storytelling. Help build a stronger communications muscle around safety research across the organization. Risk Anticipation & Mitigation Identify potential reputational, scientific, policy, or misinterpretation risks early. Develop mitigation strategies, Q&A, messaging guidance, and briefing materials for sensitive or high-profile safety research topics. Help ensure OpenAI communicates responsibly about frontier capabilities, limitations, uncertainty, and the role of ongoing safety research. You might thrive in this role if you have: 7+ years of experience in research, science, technology, or safety-related communications. Demonstrated experience working directly with scientists, engineers, researchers, or technical leaders. Strong understanding of AI, machine learning, safety research, alignment, or adjacent technical domains. Exceptional writing and editing skills, with the ability to adapt tone for expert and general audiences. Strong judgment handling complex, ambiguous, or high-stakes narratives. Experience developing proactive storytelling strategies across multiple channels, including blogs, media, video, podcasts, events, or long-form content. Experience managing multiple workstreams in a fast-paced environment with shifting priorities. Strong project management and cross-functional collaboration skills. 회사 소개
CFS (Coupang Fulfillment Services)는 쿠팡의 물류를 총괄하는 쿠팡의 계열사입니다. CFS 는 물류센터 또는 FC (Fulfillment Center) 운영을 책임지고 있으며, 업무 효율성과 전문성 제고를 통해 글로벌 커머스 기업으로 성장하기 위한 혁신을 이끌어 가고 있습니다.
쿠팡의 FC 는 상품의 입고, 적재, 포장, 출고 및 반품 등 사후 처리에 이르는 다양한 분야의 전문가들이 함께 일하고 있습니다. FC 는 단순한 물류 창고와 다르게 공장 자동화 (Factory Automation) 솔루션과 첨단 기술을 활용하고 있습니다. 제조업 생산 공장과 같이 각각의 업무를 전문화하고, 입고부터 출고까지 데이터를 기반으로 시공간을 효율적으로 관리하여 낭비를 최소화하는 등 최적의 물류 시스템을 구현해 나가고 있습니다.
CFS 는 물류 혁신을 통해 고객이 "쿠팡 없이 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말하는 세상을 만들고자 합니다. 우리의 역동적인 미래를 함께 만들고 싶다면 CFS 와 함께하세요.
직무 소개
Automation Maintenance 팀은 물류센터 내에 구축된 다양한 자동화 설비를 직접 운영·관리하며 안정적인 센터 운영을 지원하는 조직입니다. 상품 분류 설비인 소터(Sorter), 무인 이동 로봇인 자동 유도 차량(Automated Guided Vehicle)과 자율 이동 로봇(Autonomous Mobile Robot), 자동 라벨링 및 패키징 설비, 로봇 암, 컨베이어 등 핵심 자동화 장비의 유지보수와 성능 관리를 담당합니다. 또한 신규 자동화 설비 도입과 지속적인 개선 활동을 통해 현장 근로자의 작업 효율을 높이고 생산성을 극대화합니다. 이를 통해 물류 운영의 안정성과 품질을 강화하며, 쿠팡의 핵심 가치인 고객 만족 실현에 기여합니다.
업무 내용
물류센터 내 자동화 설비의 유지보수 및 예방보전 활동 수행
- 설비 예시: 컨베이어, 자동 분류기(오토소터), 자동 저장 시스템(OSR) 등
주요 설비 운영 지표 분석 및 관리
- 예시: MTBF(고장 간 평균 시간), MTTR(평균 수리 시간) 등
교대조 관리 및 조원 교육 진행
스페어 파츠 등 부품의 적정 재고 수준 관리
자격
요건
4년 이상의 기계/전기/제어 분야 경력 및 5인 이상 팀의 목표 관리 경험 보유자
설비 보전 경험 보유자
주·야간 교대근무 가능자 (교대근무 형태는 센터별 상이함)
우대
사항
자동화 설비 개선 경험을 보유하신 분
기계/전기 관련 기능사 이상의 자격증을 보유하신 분
PLC 로직/Inverter Parameter 수정 또는 HMI 작화 및 수정이 가능하신 분
기구부 국산화 이상의 개선 경험을 보유하신 분
스페어 파츠 관리 경험을 보유하신 분
설비 셋업(Set-up) 경험을 보유하신 분
근무 위치
천안6 FC : 충남 천안시 서북구 입장면 용정리 388
전형 절차 및 안내 사항
전형 절차
서류전형 - 전화면접 - 대면(화상)면접 – 최종 합격
전형절차는 직무별로 다르게 운영될 수 있으며, 일정 및 상황에 따라 변동될 수 있습니다.
전형 일정 및 결과는 지원서에 등록하신 이메일로 개별 안내 드립니다.
참고 사항
본 공고는 모집 완료 시 조기 마감될 수 있습니다.
지원서 내용 중 허위사실이 있는 경우에는 합격이 취소될 수 있습니다.
취업 보호 대상자(보훈대상자, 장애인 등)는 관련 법률에 따라 채용우대를 받을 수 있습니다.
직급과 담당 업무 범위는 후보자의 전반적인 경력과 경험 등 제반사정을 고려하여 변경될 수 있습니다. 이러한 변경이 필요할 경우, 최종 합격 통지 전 적절한 시기에 후보자와 커뮤니케이션 될 예정입니다.
채용 및 업무 수행과 관련하여 요구되는 법령상 자격이 갖추어지지 않은 경우 채용이 제한될 수 있습니다.
고용형태는 정규직으로 수습기간 12 주를 포함합니다. 단, 업무상 필요한 경우에는 상기 수습기간을 적용하지 않거나 단축 또는 연장할 수 있습니다.
개인정보 처리방침
쿠팡 그룹은 입사지원자 개인정보 처리방침(아래 링크)에 따라 귀하의 개인정보를 수집하여 처리합니다.
https://www.coupang.jobs/kr/privacy-policy
서류 반환 정책
본 고지는 『채용절차의공정화에관한법률』 제11조제6항에 따른 것 입니다.
당사 채용에 응시한 구직자 중 최종 합격이 되지 못한 구직자는 『채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률』에 따라 제출한 채용서류의 반환을 청구할 수 있음을 알려 드립니다. 다만, 홈페이지 또는 전자우편으로 제출된 경우나 구직자가 당사의 요구 없이 자발적으로 제출한 경우에는 그러하지 아니하며, 천재지변이나 그 밖에 당사에게 책임 없는 사유로 채용서류가 멸실된 경우에는 반환한 것으로 봅니다.
위2항 본문에 따라 채용 서류 반환 청구를 하는 구직자는 채용 서류 반환 청구서 [채용절차의 공정화에 관한 법률 시행규칙 별지 제 3 호 서식]를 작성하여 이메일 (
recruitingops@coupangfs.com
) 로 제출하면, 제출이 확인된 날로부터 14 일 이내에 지정한 주소지로 등기우편을 통하여 발송해 드립니다. 이 경우 등기우편요금은 수신자 부담으로 하게 되오니 유념하시기 바랍니다.
당사는 위2항 본문에 따른 구직자의 반환 청구에 대비하여 채용 여부가 확정된 날로부터 180 일간 구직자가 제출한 채용서류 원본을 보관하게 되며, 그때까지 채용서류의 반환을 청구하지 아니할 경우에는 『개인정보 보호법』에 따라 지체 없이 채용서류 일체를 파기할 예정입니다.
단, 위 1항 내지 4항의 내용은 대한민국의 노동 관계 법령이 적용되는 경우에만 적용됩니다. 그 이외의 경우에는 적용되지 않습니다.

jobs.description: Job Description Summary: The Coca-Cola Company is evolving into a more digital-first, data-driven enterprise to fuel sustainable growth, increase speed to market, and unlock new sources of value. Rapid advances in data and AI create a unique opportunity to accelerate the KO system’s next chapter of growth. In LATAM, this ambition takes shape through our data vision for the 2030 Long-Range Plan: connecting our data assets across Consumer, Customer and Enterprise into one trusted, AI-ready intelligence ecosystem, and running the business on connected intelligence rather than isolated reports. This next phase moves us from early wins to scaled, end-to-end impact — powered by a growth engine that embeds data science and agentic AI into our most critical business domains. Success demands more than technology: it requires a product-centric operating model and a culture of experimentation, data fluency, and seamless partnership between business and digital teams. Role Overview The Coca-Cola Company is seeking a Senior Manager, Data Science and Agentic AI to design, build and scale the models and AI agents that turn LATAM’s data into decisions. Sitting within the LATAM Data & Analytics team, you will take priority use cases from experimentation to production — combining classic data science (predictive/prescriptive modeling) with modern agentic AI (LLM-powered assistants and multi-step agents) on top of our governed data foundations. You will build and operationalize AI agents such as data assistants , grounding them in trusted data and business logic so they reason reliably and safely. Working on the target stack (Microsoft Fabric/ OneLake , Azure AI Foundry, Azure ML, and our in-house AI platform), you will partner with data engineering, product and governance teams to ensure every model and agent is AI-ready, monitored and cost-controlled. This is a hands-on senior individual-contributor : deep enough to build, and senior enough to shape how we design, evaluate and scale agentic solutions across the OU. What You’ll Do for Us Data Science & Modeling Build predictive and prescriptive models (forecasting, elasticity, segmentation, next-best-action) that support revenue growth, commercial execution and enterprise decisions. Take use cases from PoC to production with sound experimentation design, feature engineering, validation, and clear measurement of business impact. Analyze large, complex datasets to surface trends, drivers, risks and optimization opportunities. Agentic AI (core) Design and build AI agents and copilots — LLM-powered assistants and multi-step/agentic workflows grounded in governed data and business logic. Apply modern GenAI patterns — RAG, prompt and context engineering, tool/function calling, orchestration and multi-agent design, with semantic/ontology grounding so agents reason over meaning, not raw tables. Operationalize agents on the target stack — Azure AI Foundry + Microsoft Fabric (with Azure ML and the Nexus AI platform), including deployment, versioning and integration into business workflows. Evaluate and harden agents for production — build eval sets and guardrails; monitor accuracy, hallucination, bias and model/agent drift; track token cost against per-use-case budgets. Embed Responsible AI and governance — align with the AI-Ready Dataset guidelines and T1/T2/T3 scoring from the AI LATAM Office, ensuring lineage, auditability and safe, compliant use. Collaboration, MLOps & Adoption Partner cross- functionally with Commercial, Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain and Strategy to frame problems and land solutions that change decisions. Work with data engineering and governance to strengthen data accessibility, quality and AI-readiness, and to apply MLOps practices (CI/CD, monitoring, reproducibility). Translate technical results into business stories and clear recommendations for senior stakeholders. Champion data & AI fluency — coach analysts, share reusable patterns, and promote experimentation and evidence-based decision-making. Requirements & Qualifications Bachelor’s degree required in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Analytics or related field (Master’s a plus). 5+ years of experience in data science, machine learning or advanced analytics, including hands-on delivery of models into production. Practical experience building GenAI/agentic solutions — LLM applications, RAG, prompt/context engineering, tool calling and agent orchestration ( LangChain , Semantic Kernel, Azure AI Foundry or similar). Strong programming and ML foundations — Python (pandas, scikit-learn, and a modern deep-learning/LLM framework), SQL, and solid statistics/experimentation. Experience on cloud data & AI platforms — Azure preferred (Azure ML, Azure AI Foundry/OpenAI), plus Microsoft Fabric/Databricks; familiarity with MLOps and vector stores. Awareness of Responsible AI and governance — evaluation, guardrails, bias/drift monitoring, lineage and cost control; awareness of EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF as reference frameworks is a plus . Strong communication and business acumen — able to explain complex models and agents to technical and non-technical audiences and connect them to measurable outcomes. Collaboration in matrixed, global teams with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. Familiarity with the Beverage/System landscape (RGM, Commercial, Revenue) is a plus. What We Can Do for You Purpose with impact. Our purpose is “TO REFRESH THE WORLD . MAKE A DIFFERENCE.” Your models and agents will directly shape how LATAM grows and decides. Build at the frontier. Work on live agentic AI (NSR Agent, BI Assistant, RGM assistants) on a modern Azure/Fabric/Foundry stack, in one of the richest data ecosystems in the System. Scale and network. Collaborate across a globally networked organization, with exposure to Global DTS, Europe and leading bottlers. Growth. Grow as a data science and agentic -AI leader as we scale from early wins to enterprise-wide impact. Skills: Location(s): Mexico City/Cities: Mexico Travel Required: 00% - 25% Relocation Provided: No Job Posting End Date: October 7, 2026 Our Purpose and Growth Culture: We are taking deliberate action to nurture an inclusive culture that is grounded in our company purpose, to refresh the world and make a difference. We act with a growth mindset, take an expansive approach to what’s possible and believe in continuous learning to improve our business and ourselves. We focus on four key behaviors – curious, empowered, inclusive and agile – and value how we work as much as what we achieve. We believe that our culture is one of the reasons our company continues to thrive after 130+ years. Visit Our Purpose and Vision to learn more about these behaviors and how you can bring them to life in your next role at Coca-Cola.
